Container.Name: floppy-bundled
Container.Overview: Floppy (Bundled, Latest) follows the latest branch: the newest changes, before they reach a release. For tested releases only use Floppy (Bundled, Stable). It is the self-hosted media tracker in one container: it includes its own PostgreSQL and Valkey, so there is nothing else to install or connect. Choose three host folders (app data, database, backups). A fresh install only: it does not convert an existing SQLite or PostgreSQL Floppy. Full guide: https://github.com/dannyvfilms/Floppy/blob/latest/docs/deployment-bundled.md
Container.Requires: Nothing else. PostgreSQL and Valkey run inside this container.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the Floppy web UI listens on.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: App settings, uploaded covers and the signing secret.

Config.Name: Database
Config.Description: PostgreSQL data. Required: without it the container refuses to start rather than create a database that disappears.

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Daily database backups and exports. Restore instructions are in the guide.

Config.Name: SECRET
Config.Description: Optional. Leave blank and Floppy generates a secret once and keeps it in App Data. Back it up with your database.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone used for scheduling and displayed dates.

Config.Name: REGISTRATION
Config.Description: Allow new account sign-ups. Set to False after creating your account.

Config.Name: DEMO_ACCOUNT_ENABLED
Config.Description: Provision the public demo/demodemo account after migrations. Leave False unless you want it.

Config.Name: TMDB_API
Config.Description: TMDB API key for movie/TV metadata. Optional but recommended.

Config.Name: URLS
Config.Description: Public URL if using a reverse proxy, e.g. https://floppy.yourdomain.com

Config.Name: ADMIN_ENABLED
Config.Description: Enable the Django admin interface at /admin/.

Config.Name: WEB_CONCURRENCY
Config.Description: Gunicorn worker processes. Leave blank - Floppy sizes this from the host's memory, CPU and swap. Each extra worker holds its own resident copy of the application. If this field already shows a number from an older template, clear it and apply.

Config.Name: GUNICORN_THREADS
Config.Description: Gunicorn threads per worker. Leave blank - Floppy sizes this from the host. A fixed 4 is too many for a small host, where the detected profile would use 2.

Config.Name: DEBUG
Config.Description: Enable Django debug mode. Leave False in production - it slows every request.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID to run the container as.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID to run the container as.
